scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: go build -o omniplex ./cmd/omniplex && ln -sfn omniplex omni
scripts.build:bundled: npm run build:web && npm run build:sidecar && go build -tags bundled_sidecar -o omniplex ./cmd/omniplex && ln -sfn omniplex omni
scripts.build:sidecar: cd internal/adapter/claudecode/sidecar && npm install && bun build --compile sidecar.mjs --outfile dist/omniplex-claude-sidecar
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:web
scripts.clean: rm -f omniplex omni && rm -rf cmd/omniplex/webdist && mkdir -p cmd/omniplex/webdist && touch cmd/omniplex/webdist/.gitkeep
